title: HeartRateSettings
description: Alert settings edited on the watch. Ranges are UX limits, not medical advice.

targetBPM.description: Alert target in beats per minute.

warningFraction.description: Warning level as a fraction of targetBPM. warningBPM is targetBPM * warningFraction.

warningCooldown.description: Seconds between repeated warning haptics while heart rate stays in the warning zone.

thresholdCooldown.description: Seconds between repeated threshold haptics while heart rate stays at or above the target.

hysteresisBPM.description: Heart rate must fall this far below a boundary before that boundary can alert again.

staleTimeout.description: Seconds without a fresh sample before alerts and the live display treat the reading as stale.

batteryGuardLevel.description: Fraction of battery remaining that ends the session. 0.10 is 10%.

saveToHealth.description: When false, the workout is discarded and the app recording is the data of record.
